description: Source code for tensor type utilities in PyTorch, including backend string conversion, options stringification, and type options parsing.

methods.name: parse_privateuseone_backend
methods.description: Parses the private use one backend string, optionally for sparse backend.

methods.name: backend_to_string
methods.description: Converts a backend enum to its string representation.

methods.name: options_to_string

methods.name: options_from_string
